acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for functional layout improvements in the East Bay, look for experience with similar projects, local references, and proper licensing and insurance. Evaluate their communication style, attention to detail, and ability to understand your vision. We recommend obtaining multiple quotes and reviewing portfolios of past work. Frasheski Construction offers transparent communication, detailed proposals, and a strong track record of successful projects in the East Bay area.
